content.json:
# Conversation / User Troubleshooting
Diagnose a specific **user** or **conversation** for any Copilot Studio agent in this Application Insights resource. Pick a time range, then either type a **user id** / **conversation id** or click through the grids below (user → conversations → transcript & flow).

> ⚠️ **Tool-call caveat:** MCP tool calls (`mcp.tool`) carry no conversation id, so the flow tile overlays them by **timestamp window** — best-effort when conversations overlap in time.

parameters.name: Agent
parameters.label: Agent
parameters.query:
union
 (print value = "", label = "\u2014 All agents \u2014", ord = 0),
 (customEvents
  | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
  | where name == "BotMessageReceived"
  | extend agent = tostring(customDimensions.recipientName)
  | where isnotempty(agent)
  | distinct agent
  | project value = agent, label = agent, ord = 1)
| order by ord asc, label asc
| project value, label

content.json:
## Agents in this resource
Every Copilot Studio agent (bot) that logs to this Application Insights resource.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where name == "BotMessageReceived"
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend agent = tostring(cd.recipientName)
| where isnotempty(agent)
| summarize conversations = dcount(tostring(cd.conversationId)),
            sessions      = dcount(session_Id),
            users         = dcount(tostring(cd.fromId)),
            messages      = count(),
            lastSeen      = max(timestamp)
        by agent
| order by messages desc
content.title: Agents in this resource
content.comment: Every Copilot Studio agent (bot) that logs to this Application Insights resource.

content.json:
## Users across all agents
Sessions & conversations per user (fromId + display name where available), across every agent. Type a user id or name in the filter, or click a row to load that user's conversations below.

content.query:
let userNames = customEvents
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where name == "BotMessageSend"
    | extend cd = customDimensions
    | where isnotempty(tostring(cd.recipientName))
    | summarize userName = take_any(tostring(cd.recipientName)) by userId = tostring(cd.recipientId);
customEvents
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where name == "BotMessageReceived"
| extend cd = customDimensions
| extend userId  = tostring(cd.fromId),
         agent   = tostring(cd.recipientName),
         convId  = tostring(cd.conversationId),
         channel = tostring(split(user_Id, tostring(cd.fromId))[0])
| where isnotempty(userId)
| where "{Agent}" == "" or agent == "{Agent}"
| summarize conversations = dcount(convId),
            sessions      = dcount(session_Id),
            messages      = count(),
            agents        = make_set_if(agent, isnotempty(agent), 10),
            channels      = make_set_if(channel, isnotempty(channel), 5),
            lastSeen      = max(timestamp)
        by userId
| join kind = leftouter (userNames) on userId
| extend userName = coalesce(userName, "")
| where "{UserId}" == "" or userId contains "{UserId}" or (isnotempty(userName) and userName contains "{UserId}")
| project userId, userName, conversations, sessions, messages, agents, channels, lastSeen
| order by conversations desc
content.title: Users across all agents
content.comment: Sessions & conversations per user (fromId + display name where available), across every agent. Type a user id or name in the filter, or click a row to load that user's conversations below.

content.json:
## Conversations
Find by user id and/or conversation id (or click a user above). approxToolCalls counts MCP tool calls by timestamp window (best-effort). Click a row to open the transcript & flow.

content.query:
let toolRows = dependencies
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where name == "mcp.tool"
    | project toolTime = timestamp, opId = operation_Id, tbin = bin(timestamp, 1m);
let userNames = customEvents
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where name == "BotMessageSend"
    | extend cd = customDimensions
    | where isnotempty(tostring(cd.recipientName))
    | summarize userName = take_any(tostring(cd.recipientName)) by userId = tostring(cd.recipientId);
let convAgg = customEvents
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where name in ("BotMessageReceived", "BotMessageSend")
    | extend cd = customDimensions
    | extend convId = tostring(cd.conversationId)
    | where isnotempty(convId)
    | where "{ConversationId}" == "" or convId == "{ConversationId}"
    | summarize agent  = take_anyif(tostring(cd.recipientName), name == "BotMessageReceived" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.recipientName))),
                userId = take_anyif(tostring(cd.fromId), name == "BotMessageReceived" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.fromId))),
                started = min(timestamp),
                ended   = max(timestamp),
                userMessages = countif(name == "BotMessageReceived" and tostring(cd.type) == "message" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.text))),
                botMessages  = countif(name == "BotMessageSend" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.text)))
            by convId
    | where "{Agent}" == "" or agent == "{Agent}"
    | where userMessages + botMessages > 0
    | join kind = leftouter (userNames) on userId
    | extend userName = coalesce(userName, "")
    | where "{UserId}" == "" or userId contains "{UserId}" or (isnotempty(userName) and userName contains "{UserId}");
let convToolCounts =
    convAgg
    | extend startB = bin(started - 30s, 1m), endB = bin(ended + 30s, 1m)
    | extend nbins = toint((endB - startB) / 1m) + 1
    | mv-expand offset = range(0, nbins - 1, 1) to typeof(int)
    | extend tbin = startB + offset * 1m
    | project convId, started, ended, tbin
    | join kind = inner (toolRows) on tbin
    | where toolTime between (started - 30s .. ended + 30s)
    | summarize approxToolCalls = dcount(opId) by convId;
convAgg
| join kind = leftouter (convToolCounts) on convId
| extend approxToolCalls = coalesce(approxToolCalls, 0)
| project convId, agent, userId, userName, started, ended, userMessages, botMessages,
          approxToolCalls,
          durationMin = round(datetime_diff('second', ended, started) / 60.0, 1)
| order by started desc
content.title: Conversations
content.comment: Find by user id and/or conversation id (or click a user above). approxToolCalls counts MCP tool calls by timestamp window (best-effort). Click a row to open the transcript & flow.

content.json:
## Conversation transcript
Ordered user/agent messages for the selected conversation.

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where tostring(customDimensions.conversationId) == "{ConversationId}"
| where name in ("BotMessageReceived", "BotMessageSend")
| extend cd = customDimensions
| where (name == "BotMessageReceived" and tostring(cd.type) == "message" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.text)))
     or (name == "BotMessageSend" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.text)))
| project timestamp,
          role = iff(name == "BotMessageReceived", "user", "agent"),
          text = tostring(cd.text)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Conversation transcript
content.comment: Ordered user/agent messages for the selected conversation.

content.json:
## Conversation flow (messages + tool calls)
Messages interleaved with MCP tool calls. Tool calls are matched by TIMESTAMP WINDOW (they carry no conversation id) — treat as best-effort when conversations overlap in time.

content.query:
let conv = "{ConversationId}";
let bounds = materialize(
    customEvents
    | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where tostring(customDimensions.conversationId) == conv
    | summarize mn = min(timestamp), mx = max(timestamp));
let mn = toscalar(bounds | project mn);
let mx = toscalar(bounds | project mx);
union
 (customEvents
  | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
  | where tostring(customDimensions.conversationId) == conv
  | where name in ("BotMessageReceived", "BotMessageSend")
  | extend cd = customDimensions
  | where (name == "BotMessageReceived" and tostring(cd.type) == "message" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.text)))
       or (name == "BotMessageSend" and isnotempty(tostring(cd.text)))
  | project timestamp,
            step   = iff(name == "BotMessageReceived", "user", "agent"),
            detail = tostring(cd.text),
            latencyMs = real(null),
            ok = ""),
 (dependencies
  | where name == "mcp.tool"
  | where timestamp between (mn - 30s .. mx + 30s)
  | extend cd = customDimensions
  | project timestamp,
            step   = strcat("tool:", tostring(cd["mcp.tool.name"])),
            detail = strcat("outcome=", coalesce(tostring(cd["mcp.tool.outcome"]), tostring(cd["outcome"]), tostring(resultCode)), iif(success == false, "  [FAILED]", "")),
            latencyMs = toreal(duration),
            ok = tostring(success))
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Conversation flow (messages + tool calls)
content.comment: Messages interleaved with MCP tool calls. Tool calls are matched by TIMESTAMP WINDOW (they carry no conversation id) — treat as best-effort when conversations overlap in time.
